title: My Island Collab
html:
The My Island Collab is an event in collaboration with the game My Island! By Solstice Developers. This event brought resources like Flower of Friendship, Tree of Doom, and the Pine Tree (Stud), a variant of the pine tree.

To unlock the ability to use the Event's Hub, the Stud Headquarters, you must first complete two prerequisite quests:

  1. You must log into Oaklands and gather 1000 Studs worth of the newly added resources and 500 of any ore/mineral/rock.
  2. You must log into My Island! and gather 1000 Wood and 100 Sprouts.


Once you complete both of those quests, you will be rewarded with access to the prizes unlockable only at the Stud Headquarters. Though these resources have no monetary value, they can be sold at the Stud Headquarters. With this currency you are able to progress through a series of rewards tiers ranging from 100, 200, 500, and finally 1000 Studs.

Tier Rewards
Studs Rewards
100 Studs Vase (Stud)
200 Studs My Island Axe
500 Studs My Island Pickaxe
1000 Studs Mystery gift (Stud)
